_meta.name: retrieval_queries_synthetic_v1
_meta.provenance: 47 hand-written queries labelled against retrieval_corpus_synthetic.jsonl by the team BEFORE the first retrieval run. relevant = the passage(s) that directly state the answer (usually 1-2); an empty list marks an out-of-corpus query that must return nothing. Includes deliberately hard vocabulary-mismatch queries and out-of-corpus queries that share words with the corpus. Written by the retriever's authors, so NOT an independent test and NOT real-world accuracy.
_meta.description: query -> relevant '<source>#<page>' passages; group labels the topic.
